method: Recover pair input ranges from eigenvectors of sum_o Q_o^2. Recover common intersection from eigenvalue3ofsum pair projectors. Constrain shared directions to intersection and private directions to each pair support. All initialization coefficients random; planted parameters used only for oracle representability check.
threshold: At least4of5known targets within1%in one of two starts. All originals retained; this is a new support-guided pipeline, not a relabeled pass of unrestricted optimization.
opposing_predictions: If irrelevant input directions/basin geometry cause failure, target-support constraints should improve recovery. If it stillfails, fixed mixed product arrangement or local optimization remains problematic; do not claim native circuit failure from it.
limits: Exact support available for planted low-rank targets. Native teacher forms have full support; this directly motivates testing approximate supports from an earlier decomposition, but is not automatically a native solution.
